meta_title: WinProx — turn reports into completed tasks

social.og_title: WinProx — turn reports into completed tasks
social.og_description: Facility management for issues, tasks and field execution. From QR report to completed work.

hero.lead_intro: Receiving reports is easy. Resolving them effectively is the challenge.
hero.lead_body: WinProx ensures reports reach the right people, are turned into clear assignments, and are followed through until the task is fully completed.

how.title: Clear assignments every day through a briefing.
how.lead: WinProx collects reports and automatically turns them into clear assignments for your teams.

briefing.intro: Every morning, teams see everything clearly on one screen:

qr_history.title: One QR code, full history
qr_history.body: Every location, room, machine or installation gets a unique QR code. Reusing the same QR code automatically builds a transparent history.

languages.title: WinProx speaks your language
languages.body: To give everyone a seamless experience, WinProx automatically translates issues, tasks, announcements and communication with AI into four languages. This way, important information reaches visitors, staff and field teams in a language they understand.

sectors.title: Works in every organisation
sectors.lead: Whether public services, facility teams or production environments.

integrations.title: Works with your existing software.
integrations.body_before: WinProx does not replace your ERP, CRM or CAFM.
integrations.body_after: Through APIs and webhooks, WinProx connects easily to existing systems.

practical.title: Practical and flexible
practical.subtitle: Included by default on our powerful platform.

closing.body: WinProx brings reports, teams and execution together in one easy-to-use platform.
closing.quote: Enterprise software manages the data. WinProx manages the execution.
